'''Walter Emanus''' was a [[Professor/Legends|professor]] at the [[Corellia University/Legends|Corellia University]], where he was friends with [[Cornelius Wagglehorn]].

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] he led an archaeological expedition, including the [[Doctor/Legends|physician]] [[Tyla Grant]], to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] that excavated the [[Temple of Exar Kun]]. However, when the team uncovered the catacombs beneath the temple, they awakened the spirit of [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] and became enslaved to it, becoming the [[Cult of Exar Kun]]. He left a [[Lost Diary of Walter Emanus|diary]] of his experiences, that was later found by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Exar_professor.png|thumb|right|150px|Unused model of Walter Emanus]]
Professor Walter Emanus was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Walter Emanus was mentioned throughout the quests related to the [[W:c:swg:Exar Kun|"Exar Kun" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:CS" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 9 Notes for April 3 2008|"Chapter 9" update]], on [[April 3]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67688&month=042008|text=Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun}}</ref>

An unused model of Walter Emanus indicated that the Exar Kun cultist known as the [[Exar Kun Wordbearer]] was intended to be Professor Walter Emanus.<ref name="File">{{GalaxiesNGE}} &mdash; exar_kun_head_cultist.iff, exar_professor.iff</ref>
